claim_boundary: Static recovery-design integrity only. This policy does not infer persistence classifications, execute a restore/recovery drill, or create target deployment evidence.
unclassified_runtime_policy: No persistence or recovery classification is inferred for the other 24 required runtimes from product names or layers alone. A non-scoped runtime may resolve backup_restore_profile only after its separately validated persistence profile proves stateless; a stateful non-scoped runtime remains blocked until an explicit recovery obligation is added.
target_execution_rule: A scoped stateful recovery profile remains design_only_unexecuted and must require separate target execution evidence under the authoritative production deployment evidence manifest.
